detected_stack.notes: Full client SPA analysed. Backend (backend/) not read — inferred as Node.js REST API from API call patterns and route paths like /auth/login, /attendance, /employees.

architecture.style: SPA — feature-sliced pages, layered shell / feature-page / primitive-component
risks: PublicRoute redirects to /dashboard which has no matching Route definition — auth'd users hit 404
No index route inside Layout shell — direct / navigation shows empty Outlet
Dashboard absent from NAV_ITEMS — no sidebar link even after route is created

general.description: PublicRoute guard: redirects to /dashboard if isAuthenticated — but /dashboard route missing

default.description: Tailwind class for icon container background

input.description: PrivateRoute checks isAuthenticated and token before rendering protected content

business.description: PublicRoute prevents authenticated users from accessing /login — redirects to /dashboard (which is missing)
Sidebar NAV_ITEMS role filter — items with roles array are hidden from users not in that role list

conditional.description: Sidebar renders icon-only mode when collapsed=true; text labels and logo text hidden
StatCard renders TrendingUp/Down icon + percentage only when trend !== undefined
Sidebar renders X close button only when onClose prop is truthy (mobile use)

performance_findings.description: Recharts is not code-split; importing it in DashboardPage will add ~200KB+ to the page bundle unless React.lazy() wraps DashboardPage
fetchMe() called on every app mount when isAuthenticated — adds network round-trip before first render

security_findings.description: JWT access token and refresh token stored in localStorage — vulnerable to XSS token theft
CORS / backend security not assessed — backend/ directory not analysed

integration_points.description: All pages use lib/axios to call backend REST API
Socket.IO client installed (v4.8.3); usage not found in analysed layout/page files — likely used in Notifications
Zustand persist middleware writes/reads token, refreshToken, user, isAuthenticated

issues.description: DashboardPage.tsx does not exist — /dashboard route is missing from App.tsx route registry
Dashboard entry missing from NAV_ITEMS in Sidebar.tsx — no sidebar link to Dashboard
No <Route index> inside Layout — direct navigation to / shows empty Outlet when authenticated
Hard-coded 'SA' / 'Super Admin' in Sidebar footer and Navbar — does not read from authStore.user

recommendations.description: Create client/src/pages/dashboard/DashboardPage.tsx with 8 StatCards, Recharts AreaChart (Attendance Trend), and Recharts PieChart (By Department)
Add <Route path='dashboard' element={<DashboardPage />} /> and <Route index element={<Navigate to='dashboard' replace />} /> inside the Layout private route in App.tsx
Prepend { label: 'Dashboard', icon: LayoutDashboard, to: '/dashboard' } as the first entry in NAV_ITEMS in Sidebar.tsx
Reuse existing StatCard component for all 8 dashboard stat cards — props already match design spec (iconBg/iconColor for pastel square badge, trend for percentage, trendLabel for 'vs last month')
Use date-fns format() with 'EEEE, MMMM do yyyy' to generate the greeting subtitle dynamically from new Date()
Use Recharts AreaChart with defs linearGradient fills for Attendance Trend and PieChart with innerRadius for By Department donut chart — both packages already installed
Read user display name and initials from useAuthStore().user in Sidebar footer and Navbar instead of hard-coded 'SA'/'Super Admin'

changes: Add <Route index element={<Navigate to='dashboard' replace />} /> inside Layout route
Add <Route path='dashboard' element={<DashboardPage />} /> inside Layout route
Prepend { label: 'Dashboard', icon: LayoutDashboard, to: '/dashboard' } to NAV_ITEMS
